title: Reasoning from stated conditions
bodyMd: A fund awards a grant only if an application arrives by Friday and includes a budget. Meeting those requirements does not guarantee an award. The Orchard application arrived on Thursday without a budget. The Willow application arrived on Wednesday with a budget; its award decision is not reported.
